verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only building blocks. A machine-readable OpenAPI spec responds at vercel.com/openapi.json, though it may cover the general Vercel REST API rather than the Gateway. The docs include code snippets, and there is a models endpoint you can query without authentication. Nothing shows an interactive API explorer or in-browser runnable examples. Missing for 10: a documented interactive API reference or playground, runnable 'try it' examples, confirmation that the OpenAPI spec covers AI Gateway endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
